title: Monthly Roadmap Temperature Check & Escalation Guide for Exec Partners
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a repeatable, condensed 'temperature check' packet and escalation guide for monthly roadmap readouts to execs/stakeholders. The packet should surface signal-level health (on-track / at-risk / blocked), a short root-cause summary for risks, a recommended escalation lane (owner, impact, mitigation, decision ask), and a templated one-slide ask for any decision requiring exec attention.

Scope:
- Produce a 2-page packet template (summary + escalation matrix) and a 1-slide decision ask template.
- Define signal thresholds and data sources (KPIs, cycle burn, dev-blocking PRs, infra SLO incidents).
- Align with Eng and Design on the wording and escalation SLAs (48h triage, 1-week mitigation lane, 30-day scope change).
- Publish the packet in Confluence and add a runbook in the Console dashboard to link signals.

Why this matters: Exec readouts currently require bespoke prep per initiative. Standardizing reduces friction, surfaces hidden risks earlier, and accelerates decision velocity for capacity/priority tradeoffs.

Deliverables:
- "Temperature Check" Confluence template + example filled for Runtime Optimization initiative.
- Escalation guide with triage SLAs and owner roster.
- One-slide decision ask template (data + recommended action + fallback).
- Dashboard links mapping to each signal used (latency, error-rate, throughput commits, PR age).

Audience: PM leads, Eng leads, GTM execs, Head of Product, COO.

Success metrics:
- Reduce bespoke exec prep time by 50% (measured via survey).
- Decrease time-to-decision for escalations from average 9 days -> <=4 days in pilot group.
- Pilot with 6 initiatives in March; 80% of escalations follow the guide within 2 months.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence template created and accessible to product + eng (with example filled)
Escalation guide documented and owners assigned for each lane
One-slide decision-ask template available in Drive and used in 2 pilot readouts
Dashboard links mapped to Confluence signals and verified by Eng obs team
Stakeholder feedback score >= 4/5 in pilot retrospective
